title: Persist notes to a JSON file
summary: src/store.js loads notes from data/notes.json on start and saves on every change, writing a temporary file and renaming it so a crash cannot corrupt the notes.
findings: data/notes.json should stay out of git; added data/.gitignore.
errors: The first version failed on a missing data folder; it now creates the folder.
tests: node --test: 6 pass; restart check: notes kept
